snippet.title: Virtue Prologue Trailer
snippet.description:
Available now at playbill.pantaloon.io

Virtue: Prologue is an experimental visual novella and companion piece to the violent catharsis of Virtue and a Sledgehammer. Navigate the complex feelings of your first love: a hot, rich boy from Barcelona. Sneak into the graveyard at night with your sister, or climb a tree for high-stakes conversations. Created by Juno Menager in collaboration with Deconstructeam and Selkie Harbour, Virtue: Prologue introduces you to the characters and relationships at the heart of Virtue and a Sledgehammer.

Virtue: Prologue is available in English and is free to download from https://playbill.pantaloon.io.

Virtue and a Sledgehammer launches on Steam on October 27th.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743260/Virtue_and_a_Sledgehammer/ 

Juno Menager on Itch.io: 
https://juno-menager.itch.io/ 

Virtue and a Sledgehammer official website: 
https://www.virtueandasledgehammer.com/
